notes: The 'have' here is the light verb of the recast 'have no lack', not rule 43's possessive recasting: dropping it leaves the verb's own rendering short, so it joins חָסֵר's unit under rule 44, headed on the complement 'lack'.

The 'of' before 'gain' reaches the verb's bare object and belongs to the verb's unit; 'lack of' admits no other English preposition, which is rule 33's own test for sending such a word to the predicate.
לֹא takes the determiner 'no' that the recast negation has become (rule 15); the Hebrew gloss 'spoil' was read and set aside under rule 38.
